# Orvio 0.54

- Choose a version now shows what is really inside: next to the quality (4K, 1080p…), each version lists its audio and subtitle languages, with your languages in gold. Versions are grouped by language, yours first.
- Your languages come first: in a film with several audio tracks, Orvio now plays your language instead of the file's default track.
- New subtitle setting, Automatic: when a film does not speak your first language and has subtitles in it, they go on. Choose Off in Settings › Playback to keep subtitles off.
- Film and series pages list the language versions on offer, and the phone player shows the audio language that is playing.
